building: Maurice G. Knoy Hall of Technology
reviewer: independent audit agent; did not build or edit Knoy R21

criteria.name: Identity and footprint
findings: Official GIS/campus context and the existing stepped plan support the identity and footprint.
The local coordinate conversion is approximate rather than survey control.
R21 adds no new footprint or survey evidence.

criteria.name: Placement, orientation, and scale
findings: R21 changes no transform and adds no survey control or master-placement check.

criteria.name: Height, floors, and roof
findings: No new measured height, elevation, or roof plan was added.
The L5 interpretation and 48-foot GIS attribute conflict remain unresolved.

criteria.name: Exterior and entrances
findings: Existing official/archive photo and Street View support brick massing and interrupted glazing on the photographed faces.
The model still shows broad continuous glazing ribbons, and R21 adds no calibrated face-specific elevation or opening schedule.

criteria.name: Interior and circulation
findings: The 2019 emergency plan confirms separate lower- and upper-basement shelter areas for named departments and lists room references.
The plan does not spatially locate either zone, establish slab elevations, identify circulation geometry, or verify route continuity.
The same plan was already cited in R14/R15 and R20; R21 adds no new spatial evidence or incremental circulation confidence.

criteria.name: Technical and evidence quality
findings: R21 reopened the saved asset; object/mesh counts are 191/169.
The saved R20/R21 all-geometry and world-matrix hashes match exactly.
No unpacked external images are reported.

emergency_plan_assessment.page_4_supports: Named lower- and upper-basement severe-weather shelter groups by department.
emergency_plan_assessment.page_1_supports: Room identifiers KNOY G-011 and KNOY 457.
emergency_plan_assessment.does_not_support: Basement plan boundaries, slab levels, room placement, stairs/elevators, accessibility, or circulation continuity.
emergency_plan_assessment.incremental_value_in_R21: Explicitly records previously known source evidence; no new spatial evidence and no grade increase.

limitations: No measured elevation resolves building height, L5, roof/penthouse, or the GIS 48-foot attribute conflict.
The emergency plan's basement labels and room identifiers are non-spatial and do not verify modeled basement/circulation geometry.
The R20 sightline is approximate and perspective/occlusion prevents exact facade opening assignment.
